task.notes: One day ahead (test: two days). E10.5 hearts were dissected and E9.5 embryo portions sectioned, so this transition mixes development with a change in what was sampled (Data Protocol).

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

copy.what: real reference cells at the count rule

b0.what: B0 (feat-009): T1 chamber-only copy plus damped momentum; T2 copy plus damped momentum or bracket interpolation, both in count space

b0_gmom.what: heart try H7: B0 on a T2 extrapolation board plus T11's mean-free within-lineage momentum per reference-stage metacell, from an OT within each harmonised lineage between the start stage and the reference (vec.t1_state_transport, its constants unchanged; the PCA on the shared panel genes); Untracked cells keep B0's cells

b0_gmom_null.what: heart try H7c, a no-development control: H7's draws and stream with factors from the same pipeline fitted between two random halves of the reference stage per lineage (cross-fitted both ways), per lineage at H7's own root-mean-square size (vec.harness.t2_gmom_no_development_factors)
